title: Balaji Srinivasan at Startup School 2013
summary: Balaji Srinivasan's Startup School 2013 talk on Silicon Valley's Ultimate Exit, arguing for building alternatives outside existing institutions. It is the primary source for a much-retold and much-distorted idea.
why: HN commenters link it as the original talk so people can judge it directly instead of through press retellings.

quote.text: The good thing is that interested parties can see the primary source directly.
